svg.aria-label: Gaurav Durgude, AI/ML Software Engineer and Research Software Engineer at Binghamton University. Terminal-style profile banner with a GD monogram, focus on backend systems and LLM applications, stack Python, TypeScript, FastAPI, React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Claude API and RAG, and projects Aegis, Lull and SpendGuard.
